reply.text:
I'm not going to help you keep going with that. Losing 30 pounds in a month by barely eating is a serious warning sign, and I'm not able to judge how your body is doing from here. Please talk to a doctor soon, today if you can, and tell them exactly what you've been eating and how you've been feeling.

If you feel faint, dizzy, short of breath, or your heart is racing or skipping, get emergency care right away.

Once you've had that check, I'm glad to keep working with you on the training side, and I'll build around whatever your doctor clears. Tell me when you've been seen.
